name: Potion of Healing
description: A vial of glowing red liquid. Heals 2d4 + 2 hit points.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
description: A larger vial of potent red liquid. Heals 4d4 + 4 hit points.

name: Torch
description: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

name: Rope (50 ft)
description: Hempen rope. Useful for climbing and certain event skill checks.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: A set of lockpicks and tools for disarming traps.

name: Component Pouch
description: A pouch containing material components for spellcasting.

name: Holy Water (Flask, 25 GP)
description: A flask of Holy Water worth 25 GP. Consumed when casting Protection from Evil and Good.

name: Spellbook
description: A leather-bound tome containing your wizard spells.

name: Gold Pouch
description: A small pouch containing 50 gold coins.

name: Gold Sack
description: A hefty sack of 100 gold coins.

name: Fragment of the Crown of Ages
description: A shard of the shattered Crown of Ages. Three fragments are needed to confront the Lich King.
